Fix `plugins/catalog-backend/src/service/DefaultEntitiesCatalog.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Gate 3 security review, accepted by the person: in entityRedirect (end of the class), the caller's request.filter is applied to the claimant query (applyEntityFilterToQuery) before .distinct(...).orderBy(...).limit(2), so a caller whose filter sees only one of two entities claiming the same former ref is redirected, while the documented rule is that another entity of the same kind claiming the same former name turns that redirect into a 404. Required: keep the unfiltered live-entity check as is. Then count the claimants of the former ref WITHOUT the caller's filter (final_entity_previous_names joined with final_entities, previous_entity_ref = targetRef, final_entity not null, distinct entity_ref, limit 2) and return undefined unless exactly one. Only then, if request.filter is set, check that single target against it: a second query on final_entities where entity_id = the claimant's entity_id with applyEntityFilterToQuery({ filter: request.filter, targetQuery, onEntityIdField: 'final_entities.entity_id', knex: this.database }); return undefined when it finds no row. Otherwise return { entityRef }. Do not change any other method.
